n400._absences: Policy Manual 12 D.3: absence of more than 6 months (more than 180 days) but less than 1 year (less than 365 days) = rebuttable presumption of a break; 1 year or more = break. Departure and return days are not days of absence (12 D.4).

processing._note: National median N-400 processing time (months): time to complete half of the cases in the fiscal year. USCIS fact sheet 'Historical Processing Times Trends FY 2016-2024', data as of 2024-03-05; FY 2024 = 1 Oct 2023 to 31 Jan 2024. Office-level times are only in the USCIS processing times tool (egov.uscis.gov), which blocks automated reading: the user types the figure shown there.

forms._note: USCIS fee schedule G-1055, edition 10/16/26 (page reviewed 2026-10-16), read on 2026-10-26. N-648: Policy Manual 12 E.3 (current as of 2026-10-23). INA 320: Policy Manual 12 H.4 and N-600 instructions (01/20/25). Renunciation: 22 CFR 22.1 item 8 (eCFR, current 2026-10).
